gloss: Kagoshima (prefecture and city in southern Kyushu)

definitions.gloss: Kagoshima (prefecture and city in southern Kyushu)
definitions.explanation: The southernmost prefecture of Kyushu and its capital city, facing the active volcano Sakurajima across the bay. The prefecture also includes many islands, among them Yakushima and Amami Ōshima.

{鹿児島|かごしま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{桜島|さくらじま}→桜島：31053_sakurajima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。

{鹿児島|かごしま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{桜島|さくらじま}→桜島：31053_sakurajima⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{灰|はい}→灰：02244_hai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{降|ふ}る→降る：00839_furu⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{珍|めずら}しくない→珍しい：01200_mezurashii⟧。
examples.english: In Kagoshima, it is not unusual for ash from Sakurajima to fall on the city.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鹿児島県|かごしまけん}: Kagoshima Prefecture
- {鹿児島市|かごしまし}: Kagoshima City
- {鹿児島|かごしま}{弁|べん}: the Kagoshima dialect

CULTURAL NOTE:
The area was the old domain of {薩摩|さつま}, home of ⟦{西郷隆盛|さいごうたかもり}→西郷隆盛：31133_saigoutakamori⟧ and a leading force in the Meiji Restoration. It is known for sweet-potato ⟦{焼酎|しょうちゅう}→焼酎：19874_shouchuu⟧, black pork ({黒豚|くろぶた}), and the sweet potato itself, called ⟦さつまいも→さつまいも：10339_satsumaimo⟧ after the old province.
